description: One durable level-20 player repeatedly casts level-1 Aqua Arrow against the tier-0 Fly zone for 60 simulated seconds using a looping 0.5 random sequence.
notes: The 0.5 sequence avoids ranged critical hits while keeping attacks deterministic.
This fixture locks cast completion, mana deduction, cooldown timing, action scheduling, direct-damage resolution, and random consumption before the Rust ability runtime is implemented.
